name: polka
description: Polka (polochka.app): your agent saves HTML pages, reports and prototypes to your private shelf and gives you a link.

interface.shortDescription: Save AI pages, share by link
interface.longDescription: Polka is a private shelf for the pages, reports, dashboards and prototypes you make with ChatGPT or Codex. Ask to save a page and Polka keeps it on your shelf; ask for a link and you get an unlisted link that recipients open in the browser without an account. Links expire after 1, 7 or 30 days and can be revoked at any time. Saved works can be listed, read and revised from the chat, and each link stays bound to the version it was made for. Sign in with your Polka account in the browser; no token to copy.
